requirements.statement: Open with a Summary section: one paragraph on who, what, where, and the decision.
Then a Facts section. Every fact cites the document in the file it comes from, in square brackets: [notice of loss], [police report], [invoice 1].

source: if (!m) return { ok: true, detail: 'no Facts section', spans: [] };
if (raw.trim()) sents.push({ s: raw.trim(), idx: secStart + mm.index + raw.indexOf(raw.trim()) });
const ok = cites.length > 0 && cites.every(c => names.some(n => n === c || n.startsWith(c) || c.startsWith(n)));
if (!ok) bad.push({ start: idx, end: idx + s.length, why: 'fact without a citation to a file document' });
detail: bad.length ? bad.length + ' uncited fact(s)' : 'every fact cites a file document',
means: Each sentence in Facts that states a fact carries a bracketed citation naming a document in the file.

requirements.statement: Then a Coverage analysis section. The coverage conclusion cites the policy clause it rests on, and every exclusion that could apply is addressed and cited.

source: (text, request, material) => { const m = text.match(/^## Coverage analysis[\s\S]*?(?=^## |$(?![\s\S]))/m); if (!m) return null; const sec = m[0]; const cites = [...sec.matchAll(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g)].map(x => x[1].toLowerCase()); const hasPolicy = cites.some(c => /policy/.test(c)); const clause = /clause\s+\d+(\.\d+)?|exclusion\s+\d+(\.\d+)?/i.test(sec); return { ok: hasPolicy && clause, detail: hasPolicy && clause ? 'coverage conclusion cites a policy clause' : 'coverage analysis lacks a cited policy clause', spans: hasPolicy && clause ? [] : [{start: m.index, end: m.index + sec.length, why: 'no cited policy clause'}] }; }
means: The Coverage analysis cites a numbered policy clause with a policy citation. Whether every exclusion that could apply is addressed is judged by the person.

requirements.statement: Then a Decision section: covered or not covered, and under which clause.

source: (text, request, material) => { const sec = text.split(/^## /m).find(s => /^Decision/i.test(s)); if (!sec) return { ok: false, detail: 'no Decision section', spans: [] }; const ok = /\b(not covered|covered|accepted|declined)\b/i.test(sec) && /clause\s+\d+(\.\d+)?|\b\d+\.\d+\b/i.test(sec); return { ok, detail: ok ? 'Decision states coverage status and a clause' : 'Decision lacks a coverage status or clause number', spans: ok ? [] : [{start: text.indexOf(sec), end: text.indexOf(sec)+sec.length, why: 'missing status or clause'}] }; }
means: The Decision section states covered or not covered and names the clause it rests on.

requirements.statement: End with a Reserve section. The reserve equals the sum of the invoices in the file, less any excess the schedule applies, and cites the invoices.

source: (text, request, material) => { const m = text.match(/^## Reserve[\s\S]*$/m); if (!m) return null; const sec = m[0]; const cites = [...sec.matchAll(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g)].map(x => x[1].toLowerCase()); const invoiceCites = cites.filter(c => /invoice/.test(c)); const ok = invoiceCites.length > 0; return { ok, detail: ok ? 'reserve cites invoices' : 'reserve cites no invoice', spans: ok ? [] : [{start: m.index, end: m.index + sec.length, why: 'no invoice citation'}] }; }
means: The Reserve section cites the invoices from the file.

requirements.statement: Never speculate about the insured's intent or honesty.
Take every date, name and figure from the file: add none of your own.

source: (text, request, material) => { const body = text.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g,''); const dates = [...body.matchAll(/\b\d{1,2}\s+(?:January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{4}\b/gi)].map(x => x[0]); const corpus = material.map(m => m.text).join(' ').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' '); const bad = []; for (const d of dates) if (!corpus.includes(d.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' '))) bad.push(d); const idx = []; let at = 0; for (const b of bad) { const i = text.indexOf(b, at); idx.push({start: i, end: i + b.length, why: 'date not in the file'}); } return { ok: bad.length === 0, detail: bad.length ? bad.length + ' date(s) not in file' : 'every date is in the file', spans: idx }; }
means: Each date written in the memo appears in the file material.

requirements.statement: Every figure in the work is one the request or the material gives.
I keep paragraphs to 5 sentences at most.
I hedge rarely: at most 2 hedging words per thousand.
The Summary section runs 25 to 33 words in my pieces.
The Facts section runs 47 to 65 words in my pieces.

Write none of the moves that mark text as machine-written (announcing an insight others "miss", grading your own list, "the single most", announcing candour, "that's the whole game", reading the reader's mind, one thing "wearing another's clothes", a contrastive verdict as the opening line, an em dash, a run of three or more very short sentences).
No mechanical errors: spelling, agreement, punctuation.
